data.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/prompts/strata/posture-dialog.md (dialog). One Socratic turn presenting STRATA_DETECTION_SOURCE, detected template(s), _commit pin(s), _src_path(s), and the upgrade hint as the dialog's pre-filled default. Four responses: yes / edit / not Strata / [I no longer use Strata]. `not Strata` cleanup removes Strata tags from in-memory stack array; comment in project-understanding.md notes \"User declined Strata configuration on YYYY-MM-DD\". Non-interactive context (no TTY): default to `yes` with audit log; documented in README.md. Strata-removal 4th response removes Posture section + footguns + Strata commands.* values.
**Why**: Single-turn UX = one yes/edit/no click for non-tech user.
**Scope**:
- IN: Dialog content; 4 response paths; not-Strata cleanup logic; non-interactive auto-yes with audit log; strata-removal logic (4th path) reverses prior writes.
- OUT: Multi-turn refinement (single-turn requirement); multi-template disambiguation (A0 handles natively).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, dialog turn count = 1 across all detected variants ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, `yes` response completes phase with no content changes when fresh-from-A1 ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, `not Strata` removes Strata tags from in-memory stack array and logs the decline date ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, no-TTY context auto-yes path executes and emits audit log ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, 4th response (`[I no longer use Strata]`) reverses commands.* writes, removes footgun markers, removes Posture section ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for each response path

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Pre-filled defaults reduce user effort to a single confirmation
- [Reliability] Audit log records auto-yes path for traceability

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a non-technical user, posture-dialog.md presents one Socratic turn with four pre-filled responses
